name.zh: 华为 Atlas 960E 超节点（4,032 NPU，NPO 光互联）
name.en: Huawei Atlas 960E SuperPoD (4,032 NPUs, NPO optical interconnect)

name.zh: 4 平面 × 两层，radix 1,024，每 NPU 4 个 scale-out 口（HAC-D a960e-ub 模板默认，主算例）
name.en: 4 planes × 2 tiers, radix 1,024, 4 scale-out ports per NPU (HAC-D a960e-ub template default, main case)

basis.zh: HC2026 发布：超节点之间两层四平面 Clos 至 51.2 万 NPU；UBG 交换机最大 1,024 口；每 NPU 4 口、每平面 1 口为假设
basis.en: HC2026 release: two-tier four-plane Clos between SuperPoDs to 512,000 NPUs; UBG switch radix up to 1,024; 4 ports per NPU, one per plane, assumed

name.zh: 2 平面 × 两层，radix 1,024，每 NPU 2 个 scale-out 口
name.en: 2 planes × 2 tiers, radix 1,024, 2 scale-out ports per NPU

superpod.source: Huawei HUAWEI CONNECT 2026 Atlas 960E release and UnifiedBus release 2026-09-17 (4,096 NPUs, orthogonal full liquid cooling, 5,500 Hi-ONE NPO engines at 7.2 Tb/s replacing 48,000 × 800G modules, LinkDevice 176 × 1.6 Tb/s, two-tier four-plane Clos to 512,000 NPUs); 智东西 2026-09-19 (56 + 14 cabinets, 72 Ascend + 18 Kunpeng per cabinet, 8-NPU compute blades; single media source)
superpod.note: vendor headline 4,096 NPUs; cabinet counts and NPUs per cabinet from a single media source (4,032)

superpod.computeRacks.source: 智东西 2026-09-19: 56 compute + 14 interconnect cabinets; in-cabinet switch blades interconnect 72 Ascend + 18 Kunpeng (read per cabinet, an inference); 8-NPU compute blades (single media source; 56 × 72 = 4,032 ≠ 4,096; the same article puts the 196 km copper saving per cabinet instead of per SuperPoD)

superpod.commRacks.source: 智东西 2026-09-19: 56 compute + 14 interconnect cabinets; in-cabinet switch blades interconnect 72 Ascend + 18 Kunpeng (read per cabinet, an inference); 8-NPU compute blades (single media source; 56 × 72 = 4,032 ≠ 4,096; the same article puts the 196 km copper saving per cabinet instead of per SuperPoD)

superpod.nodesPerRack.source: 智东西 2026-09-19: 56 compute + 14 interconnect cabinets; in-cabinet switch blades interconnect 72 Ascend + 18 Kunpeng (read per cabinet, an inference); 8-NPU compute blades (single media source; 56 × 72 = 4,032 ≠ 4,096; the same article puts the 196 km copper saving per cabinet instead of per SuperPoD)

superpod.podSwitchRadix.source: Huawei UnifiedBus release (HUAWEI CONNECT 2026-09-17): in-cabinet LinkBlade (cableless), cross-cabinet LinkDevice 176 ports × 1.6 Tb/s (RTT ≤ 2 µs), UBG switch radix up to 1,024

superpod.opticalEnginesPerNpu.source: Huawei, Atlas 960E SuperPoD release (HUAWEI CONNECT 2026-09-17): 4,096 NPUs, orthogonal full liquid cooling, 5,500 Hi-ONE NPO engines (7.2 Tb/s) replacing 48,000 × 800G modules; two-tier four-plane Clos to 512,000; 99.8 % system availability (definition not given)

superpod.rackSwitches.source: Fabric counts: 5.5 LinkDevice ports per NPU (2.2 TB/s ÷ 2 ÷ 1.6 Tb/s) → 126 LinkDevices per 4,032 NPUs (9 per interconnect cabinet); 5 LinkBlade switch chips per cabinet; 4 scale-out ports per NPU, one per plane, 1,024-port switches

superpod.podUplinksPerNpu.source: Fabric counts: 5.5 LinkDevice ports per NPU (2.2 TB/s ÷ 2 ÷ 1.6 Tb/s) → 126 LinkDevices per 4,032 NPUs (9 per interconnect cabinet); 5 LinkBlade switch chips per cabinet; 4 scale-out ports per NPU, one per plane, 1,024-port switches

scaleOut.source: Huawei, Atlas 960E SuperPoD release (HUAWEI CONNECT 2026-09-17): 4,096 NPUs, orthogonal full liquid cooling, 5,500 Hi-ONE NPO engines (7.2 Tb/s) replacing 48,000 × 800G modules; two-tier four-plane Clos to 512,000; 99.8 % system availability (definition not given)
scaleOut.note: two tiers, four planes; ports per NPU and radix assumed (Fabric counts: 5.5 LinkDevice ports per NPU (2.2 TB/s ÷ 2 ÷ 1.6 Tb/s) → 126 LinkDevices per 4,032 NPUs (9 per interconnect cabinet); 5 LinkBlade switch chips per cabinet; 4 scale-out ports per NPU, one per plane, 1,024-port switches)

scaleOut.portsPerNpu.source: Fabric counts: 5.5 LinkDevice ports per NPU (2.2 TB/s ÷ 2 ÷ 1.6 Tb/s) → 126 LinkDevices per 4,032 NPUs (9 per interconnect cabinet); 5 LinkBlade switch chips per cabinet; 4 scale-out ports per NPU, one per plane, 1,024-port switches

scaleOut.radix.source: Huawei UnifiedBus release (HUAWEI CONNECT 2026-09-17): in-cabinet LinkBlade (cableless), cross-cabinet LinkDevice 176 ports × 1.6 Tb/s (RTT ≤ 2 µs), UBG switch radix up to 1,024
scaleOut.radix.note: the UBG maximum radix used as the scale-out switch radix

assumed.zh: 每柜 9 个 8 卡计算刀片（72 NPU）与 18 颗鲲鹏，56 计算柜 + 14 互联柜（智东西单一媒体来源；56 × 72 = 4,032 ≠ 厂商标称 4,096）
assumed.en: 9 compute blades of 8 NPUs (72 NPUs) and 18 Kunpeng per cabinet, 56 compute + 14 interconnect cabinets (single media source; 56 × 72 = 4,032 ≠ the vendor headline 4,096)

assumed.zh: 每柜 5 片 LinkBlade 交换芯片；每 NPU 5.5 个 LinkDevice 口（2.2 TB/s ÷ 2 ÷ 1.6 Tb/s）接 176 口 LinkDevice
assumed.en: 5 LinkBlade switch chips per cabinet; 5.5 LinkDevice ports per NPU (2.2 TB/s ÷ 2 ÷ 1.6 Tb/s) into 176-port LinkDevices
NPO optics: 1.343 Hi-ONE engines per NPU (5,500 / 4,096) carrying 5.86 800G-equivalent links (48,000 / 2 / 4,096)

assumed.zh: scale-out：每 NPU 4 口、4 平面各 1 口、两层 Clos、radix 1,024（UBG 最大 radix）、无收敛、每链路 2 只光模块
assumed.en: scale-out: 4 ports per NPU, one per plane, two-tier Clos, radix 1,024 (the UBG maximum), non-blocking, 2 transceivers per link

ubLabel.zh: 柜内 LinkBlade + 跨柜 LinkDevice + NPO 光
ubLabel.en: in-cabinet LinkBlade + cross-cabinet LinkDevice + NPO optics

podLabel.zh: 超节点 4,032 NPU：56 计算柜 + 14 互联柜
